title: SessionSettledPayload

settledAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

by.description: Who settled a session: user, auto-idle (quiet past the idle span), auto-merge (its pull request merged), routine (it is a routine's firing that ended silent, so it delivered nothing and left the active list).

description: session.settled: the session moved to the settled shelf; its settledOverride is settled.
